title: Sine In-out
description: Đi tới rồi về theo sine.inOut, dùng cho chuyển động lặp trôi nổi, nhịp thở êm như mơ.inOut, yoyo).

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 100 % in 2000 ms sine.inOut and back to 0 by 4000 ms (yoyo), looping. Rule: floating loops and breathing, 2–4 s cycles; dreamy and calm. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: half: nửa chu kỳ (2 s) · amount · repeat (yoyo).
